calculator_results.title: History persists after activity restart and can restore an expression
calculator_results.expected: History shows 1+1 = 2 and restores the expression
calculator_results.actual: history=History · 7 | Clear | Close history | = 0.3 | 200+10% | 27th Oct, 08:43 | = 220 | √(9) | = 3 | sin(30) | = 0.5 | 1+1 | 27th Oct, 08:44 | = 2; restored=MyCalc | STANDALONE | 1+1 | = 2
calculator_results.comment: The history entry survived process restart and restored its expression.

calculator_results.title: Grouped history card restores and re-evaluates without Error
calculator_results.expected: History card re-evaluates to 123457 without Error
calculator_results.comment: The grouped expression was restored and evaluated successfully; display commas did not contaminate the calculation.

calculator_results.title: Chained calculations retain unrounded precision
calculator_results.comment: After 1 ÷ 3 =, the UI result was ['MyCalc', 'STANDALONE', '0.3333333333']; multiplying by 3 did not return 1. This is consistent with the screen feeding its rounded display string back into the next expression.

calculator_results.title: Scientific-notation result can be used in the next expression
calculator_results.comment: Initial 10^15 display was ['MyCalc', 'STANDALONE', '1e+15']; adding +1 left an unchanged exponent result or produced Error. This is consistent with exponent-formatted display text not being accepted as a numeric literal by the expression validator/parser.

user_results.title: Inspect standalone MyCalc identity
user_results.expected: MyCalc is visibly distinct as the standalone app
user_results.actual: World time | MyCalc | STANDALONE | History | More options | 1e+15+1 | Error | Toggle the scientific keys | Close the extra keys | √( | π | ^ | ! | Deg | sin( | cos( | tan( | Inv | e | ln( | log( | AC | ( ) | % | ÷ | 7 | 8 | 9 | × | 4 | 5 | 6 | − | 1 | 2 | 3 | + | 0 | . | ⌫ | =
user_results.comment: The installed standalone calculator identifies itself in the visible app header.

user_results.title: Evaluate implicit multiplication
user_results.actual: input=MyCalc | STANDALONE | 2(5+2)2 | = 28; result=MyCalc | STANDALONE | 28
user_results.comment: The user-entered 2(5+2)2 expression evaluated as implicit multiplication to 28.

user_results.title: Replace a pending operator
user_results.expected: 10+ then minus shows 10−
user_results.actual: MyCalc | STANDALONE | 10− | = 10
user_results.comment: The trailing plus was replaced by minus; no evaluation was required.

user_results.title: Evaluate with a trailing plus
user_results.expected: 5+ then equals shows 10
user_results.actual: MyCalc | STANDALONE | 5
user_results.comment: Pressing equals after 5+ did not produce 10.

user_results.title: Check Indian digit grouping
user_results.expected: 123456 displays as 1,23,456
user_results.actual: MyCalc | STANDALONE | 1,23,456 | = 1,23,456
user_results.comment: Indian digit grouping was visible while typing the six-digit number.

user_results.title: Evaluate inverse sine in degree mode
user_results.expected: Inv then sin(0.5) = 30
user_results.actual: inverse key=sin⁻¹; display=MyCalc | STANDALONE | 30
user_results.comment: Inverse sine of 0.5 in degree mode returned 30.

user_results.title: Delete one character at the caret
user_results.expected: 123 then Backspace leaves 12
user_results.actual: MyCalc | STANDALONE | 12 | = 12
user_results.comment: The caret was placed at the end and one Backspace removed exactly one character.

user_results.title: Hold number to select and show actions
user_results.expected: Visible selection and Cut/Copy/MAdd/MUse actions
user_results.actual: OCR toolbar=Copy; Cut; MAdd; MUse; hierarchy=World time | MyCalc | STANDALONE | History | More options | 1,23,456 | = 1,23,456 | Toggle the scientific keys | Open the extra keys | AC | ( ) | % | ÷ | 7 | 8 | 9 | × | 4 | 5 | 6 | − | 1 | 2 | 3 | + | 0 | . | ⌫ | =
user_results.comment: The screenshot visibly exposed the floating selection toolbar; OCR is used because Android omits this popup from UiAutomator.

user_results.title: Drag while holding to change the selected portion
user_results.expected: Selection changes during an uninterrupted hold-and-drag
user_results.actual: The emulator input API could not reproduce the app-specific stationary hold-then-drag gesture; no product failure is inferred from this attempt.
user_results.comment: The user-facing control was not available to this emulator run.

user_results.title: Copy then paste within the calculator
user_results.expected: Clipboard restores exactly 123456
user_results.actual: MyCalc | STANDALONE | 1,23,456 | = 1,23,456
user_results.comment: Copy then Paste restored the digits within the calculator app; external app handoff was intentionally not tested.

user_results.title: Cut a held number and type into the gap
user_results.expected: Selection is removed; next digit is 7
user_results.actual: MyCalc | STANDALONE | 7 | = 7
user_results.comment: Cut removed the held number and the next keypad digit became the expression.

user_results.title: Clear a held selection with AC
user_results.expected: Held text and selection toolbar both clear
user_results.actual: display=MyCalc | STANDALONE | 0; OCR after AC=850 © v.46 3 FA MyCalc STANDALONE > p v AC 0 %
user_results.comment: AC removed the held text and dismissed the floating selection toolbar.

user_results.title: Tap inside a number and insert a digit
user_results.expected: 9 is inserted at the caret, not appended
user_results.actual: MyCalc | STANDALONE | 12,39,456 | = 12,39,456
user_results.comment: OCR located the expression and a tap 58% across its visible glyph bounds inserted 9 between existing digits.

user_results.title: Hold empty expression-box space for caret menu
user_results.expected: MUse/Paste/Select all caret actions
user_results.actual: OCR caret menu=MUse; Paste; Select all
user_results.comment: The screenshot shows the empty-box caret menu; OCR is used because the Android floating menu is omitted from UiAutomator.

user_results.title: Verify tapping the expression does not open a device keyboard
user_results.expected: No Android soft keyboard shown
user_results.actual: input_method not shown
user_results.comment: Android's input-method diagnostics did not report a visible software keyboard after tapping the expression.

user_results.title: Open the three-dot menu
user_results.expected: Overflow exposes Effects and the calculator actions
user_results.actual: Haptics: On | Clear memory | View memory | Show as fraction | Key shape | Effects | 851 | © | wa | Ey | ‘STANDALONE, | MyCalc | Haptics: | On | Clear | memory | View | memory | Show | as | fraction | Key | shape | Effects | . | 8
user_results.comment: The overflow menu exposed Effects plus calculator menu actions. This smoke check does not verify the exact item count or reorder behavior.

user_results.title: Open key-shape picker and select Circle
user_results.expected: Picker presents Circle/Squircle/Pill/Rounded square/No shape
user_results.actual: picker=Circle; Squircle; Pill; Rounded square; No shape; selected=Circle
user_results.comment: The picker exposed at least four named key silhouettes and accepted a Circle selection. Persistence and pixel-perfect geometry are not inferred from this one view.

user_results.title: Switch calculator between Light and Dark themes
user_results.expected: Both themes apply to the calculator while its expression remains visible
user_results.actual: Settings was not exposed from the calculator's MySpace home: ['Haptics: On', 'Clear memory', 'View memory', 'Show as fraction', 'Key shape', 'Effects']
user_results.comment: The user-facing control was not available to this emulator run.

user_results.title: Scan visible calculator labels for ad indicators
user_results.expected: No visible ad labels on the calculator screen
user_results.actual: Scanned 6 visible labels; no ad indicator
user_results.comment: No ad-like text appeared on the sampled calculator screen; this does not certify the app's network or SDK behavior.

user_results.title: Store a number with MAdd and use it in an expression
user_results.expected: MUse replaces the selected 4 in 3+4 with 123456; result 123459
user_results.actual: after MUse=MyCalc | STANDALONE | 3+1,23,456 | = 1,23,459; after equals=MyCalc | STANDALONE | 1,23,459
user_results.comment: The stored value appeared in the expression but the calculator did not evaluate the expected sum 123459.

user_results.title: Open the calculator memory list
user_results.expected: Saved value 123456 is visible in View memory
user_results.actual: Memory | Close memory | 1,23,456 | Move up from place 1 | Move down from place 1 | 852 | © | v.46 | 3 | FA | MyCalc | ‘STANDALONE | 159 | Memory | 1,23,456 | 7 | 8 | 9 | 4 | ) | 1 | 2
user_results.comment: The calculator's memory list displayed the value saved through MAdd.

user_results.title: Choose a calculator keypress effect
user_results.expected: Effects picker opens and accepts an animation choice
user_results.actual: choices=✓ Spring · bounce back with overshoot; Pulse · quick fade pulse; bounce; Pulse; fade; pulse; selected one option
user_results.comment: The Effects picker exposed user-selectable calculator animation options. This smoke test confirms access and selection, not frame-by-frame animation timing.

limits: Direct APK evidence comes from Android 14/API 34 emulator UI actions, screenshots and hierarchy dumps.
Only calculator screens and calculator-specific settings are exercised; other MySpace apps are out of scope.
The calculator ad check scans sampled visible text; it is not a network or third-party SDK audit.
Source-CI runs are reported separately from direct APK results.
